shortDescription: Information module for Security Advisories Results Network Devices Network Device Id Advisories

options.name: cvssBaseScore
options.description: CvssBaseScore query parameter. Return advisories with cvssBaseScore greater than this cvssBaseScore. E.g. 8.5.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id query parameter. Id of the security advisory.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page. Minimum value is 1. Maximum value is 500. Default value is 500.

options.name: networkDeviceId
options.description: NetworkDeviceId path parameter. Id of the network device.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page; the first record is numbered 1. Default value is 1.

options.name: order
options.description: Order query parameter. Whether ascending or descending order should be used to sort the response. Available values asc, desc. Default value is asc.

options.name: securityImpactRating
options.description: SecurityImpactRating query parameter. Return advisories with this securityImpactRating. Available values CRITICAL, HIGH.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. A property within the response to sort by.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
